tw-wi-dover-gregg-hoard.t: A Racine Co probate (Sarena Greig, d. 3 Nov 1893, Town of Norway) is a candidate for the story but is unconfirmed. Racine and Burlington papers Nov 1893 to 1895 carry no death notice or hoard story; the Waterford Post is not online.
src: Racine County probate index, case 117-1989 (candidate only)
